scope: production implementation; not the historical HTML prototype checks

cases.title: Approved source custody
cases.exercise: Compare the bundled approved HTML and original manifest to the uploaded mockup.
cases.expected: The HTML digest matches; source screenshots remain unchanged; no mock sample becomes real project data.

cases.title: Mounted Ratatui cabinet
cases.exercise: Mount the actual WASM cabinet with real artifact entries in the shared right-hand host.
cases.expected: The cabinet uses the existing Ratatui/Ratzilla host, retains the approved gallery composition, and is not a standalone HTML substitution.

cases.title: Stable artifact identity
cases.exercise: List the same artifact with several revisions and duplicate titles on other artifacts.
cases.expected: One card per authorized artifact identity; revisions remain attached to that card; titles never serve as IDs.

cases.title: Cross-session original opening
cases.exercise: In session A, open a project artifact produced in session B.
cases.expected: The represented artifact and revision open without switching the foreground conversation or discarding its draft.

cases.title: Scoped paginated catalog
cases.exercise: Browse a project with more entries than one catalog page and artifacts outside its authorized scope.
cases.expected: Pagination is complete under the service contract; foreign/inaccessible items do not leak; total versus loaded count is labeled accurately.

cases.title: Real search filters and ordering
cases.exercise: Search a title/description beyond the first page, change kind filters, and update a run status.
cases.expected: Search scope is honest; filters work; accepted-date ordering is stable; status updates do not arbitrarily reorder cards.

cases.title: No live preview fallback
cases.exercise: Provide a contribution whose preview fallback resolves to a live thing/application presentation.
cases.expected: Cabinet refuses the live fallback and uses an inert representation or honest type illustration; no run/live slot is created.

cases.title: Browsing has no external effects
cases.exercise: Browse and scroll both modes with applications whose normal opening can start work.
cases.expected: No application execution, network mutation, credential grant, or hidden active iframe is caused by browsing; original opening retains existing permissions.

cases.title: Preview preference truth table
cases.exercise: Exercise both presets with theme_default, pixel, and full_fidelity, under light and dark terminal profiles.
cases.expected: Expressive/default is pixel; Calm/default is full fidelity; either explicit choice wins independently of light/dark or palette.

cases.title: Saved override and reset
cases.exercise: Choose Pixel under Calm, reload, switch preset/palette, then choose Use theme default.
cases.expected: The explicit choice survives the supported persistence scope; reset restores default resolution without losing other preferences or flashing the wrong mode.

cases.title: Cabinet and terminal lifetimes
cases.exercise: Open Cabinet without a model configured, then switch to/from an existing running terminal.
cases.expected: Cabinet starts no agent session; existing terminal identity, task, scroll, and approvals remain intact.

cases.title: Grounded descriptions
cases.exercise: Provide missing page counts, a Markdown document, authored text, and a stale derived summary.
cases.expected: No invented PDF label/page count/summary; provenance and revision are retained; stale summaries are not represented as current.

cases.title: Revision race on open
cases.exercise: Display revision A; publish B between pointer-down and the accepted open action.
cases.expected: The command targets the revision represented by the selected card; a newer-revision notice may appear; no silent substitution.

cases.title: Image normalization and fit
cases.exercise: Convert portrait, panoramic, EXIF-rotated, transparent, light, dark, and unsupported-color-profile fixtures.
cases.expected: Orientation and declared color/alpha normalization are correct; aspect is preserved; crop is explicit; unsupported profiles and oversized data are handled honestly.

cases.title: Pixel-grid and palette bounds
cases.exercise: Convert reference image fixtures and display at device scale 1, 2, and a fractional scale.
cases.expected: Indices are in range and color count stays within profile; display uses nearest-neighbor with no blur/stretch; compact/reflow behavior is explicit.

cases.title: Source-specific versus generic art
cases.exercise: Preview a PDF, Markdown document, non-game app, unfamiliar game, missing app capture, and unknown artifact kind.
cases.expected: Correct kind/source drives the visual; only a real PDF receives that label; no generic maze is shown as a different app; type illustrations are identifiable.

cases.title: Recipe extension without renderer branch
cases.exercise: Register a seventh safe recipe through the contribution seam.
cases.expected: The gallery consumes its standard result without a new artifact-kind branch in the card renderer or a second artifact registry.

cases.title: Graph topology honesty
cases.exercise: Render a graph with cross-links, disconnected nodes, and a dense graph requiring simplification.
cases.expected: No invented relationships; omitted/clustered detail is marked and traceable; existing view/lens semantics are preserved.

cases.title: Chart geometry from data
cases.exercise: Render known donut values, a tiny category, zero total, negative unsupported values, and NaN.
cases.expected: Valid category occupied-area fractions meet the 0.03 target; tiny subpixel categories are described honestly; invalid data yields a named fallback, not made-up numbers.

cases.title: Bounded malformed and large input
cases.exercise: Submit malformed encodings, decompression-heavy/oversized headers, excessive dimensions, and an over-budget preview job.
cases.expected: Preallocation checks and decoder support are verified; bounded worker outcome is reported; the cabinet stays usable and original content remains intact.

cases.title: Deterministic raster generation
cases.exercise: Run each recipe repeatedly against pinned normalized data, then compare supported execution targets.
cases.expected: Same-target normalized indices/palettes agree exactly; versions/seeds/order are recorded; cross-target disagreement is isolated in cache identity rather than hidden.

cases.title: Correct cache dependencies
cases.exercise: Change only theme, then source revision, crop, recipe version, logical profile, and caption timestamp.
cases.expected: Theme reuses indices but remaps palette; output-changing inputs invalidate the right layer; relative-time labels do not rebuild pixel geometry.

cases.title: Out-of-order async work
cases.exercise: Delay an old preview; change source revision, project, palette, and preview mode before its completion.
cases.expected: Late work cannot replace the current card; selected binding and anchor remain coherent; unused buffers are released.

cases.title: Whole-terminal theme projection
cases.exercise: Switch Neutral/Paper/Slate/Forest profile fixtures while viewing Cabinet and a terminal containing code, diffs, prompt, approvals, and errors.
cases.expected: All roles update coherently from one adapter; no leftover forced gold headings or privileged purple/gold branding; source pixels/original content are not corrupted.

cases.title: Invalid custom-theme repair
cases.exercise: Supply a gamut-extreme or low-contrast custom theme.
cases.expected: Actual sRGB roles are repaired or a same-mode known valid fallback is selected with diagnostics; no silent invalid palette is treated as passing.

cases.title: Rendered contrast pairs
cases.exercise: Measure real labels and state indicators on base, raised, selected, and applicable terminal/diff surfaces.
cases.expected: Applicable normal text passes unrounded 4.5:1 and essential nontext 3:1; decorative/art pixels are classified correctly; missing measurements are unresolved.

cases.title: Faithful originals stay faithful
cases.exercise: Compare original gallery thumbnails and opened originals through several terminal palettes.
cases.expected: No terminal palette wash affects original image/screenshot content; explicit artifact-native theme behavior remains its own contract.

cases.title: Preview and frame alignment
cases.exercise: Resize cabinet, zoom the page, load fonts late, scroll, and expand/restore at different device scales.
cases.expected: Preview, clip, card target, and semantic-control geometry share an epoch and agree within 1 CSS px in controlled captures; no drift or double-dispatch.

cases.title: Keyboard pointer and touch parity
cases.exercise: Select cards by arrow keys, open with Enter/pointer/touch, resize by pointer and keyboard, and return with Escape.
cases.expected: Same IDs/actions are used; selection does not execute apps; return restores focus or a sensible surviving target; touch targets meet applicable rules.

cases.title: Accessible semantic ownership
cases.exercise: Inspect accessibility tree and operate the cabinet using a screen reader.
cases.expected: One actionable semantic node per control/card; names/descriptions and selected/focus states are meaningful; no duplicate cell-text traversal or keyboard trap.

cases.title: Search input and shortcut scope
cases.exercise: Enter composed Unicode text, paste content, use a mobile keyboard, and type / in another editor.
cases.expected: Input remains correct; focus is not stolen; the cabinet shortcut only acts in its allowed context; the global command palette is not silently replaced.

cases.title: Draft and task continuity
cases.exercise: Keep a draft/attachments and a running terminal operation, then open artifacts, switch styles, switch tabs, and expand/restore.
cases.expected: All existing owners preserve their draft, undo, references, task identity, and state; no invisible cancellation or fresh session.

cases.title: Layout width conservation
cases.exercise: Capture 1536 and 1280 desktop widths plus 390 × 844 and 320 CSS px narrow conditions.
cases.expected: Measured allocation follows the width budget; desktop center meets the target when docked; otherwise an intentional overlay/reflow occurs; no font shrinking to retain columns.

cases.title: Text scaling and long labels
cases.exercise: Use long titles/descriptions, large user text, and 200% text enlargement.
cases.expected: Cards reduce columns or reflow; essential content and controls stay usable; titles/descriptions are not lost behind fades or tiny forced typography.

cases.title: Honest state vocabulary
cases.exercise: Exercise empty, loading, refreshing, preview failure, unsupported kind, lost connection, and missing original.
cases.expected: Each is distinguishable; stale/offline is not empty; preview failure does not claim the original is absent; retry is available only where real.

cases.title: Visual and recognition acceptance
cases.exercise: Compare six real-kind fixtures plus the extended recognition corpus against the approved docked and expanded design.
cases.expected: Recognition, terminal visual language, composition, and descriptions are acceptable; fixture failures are named rather than averaged into a beauty score.

cases.title: Permission change and cache privacy
cases.exercise: Revoke access while a preview is visible/in flight; switch between authorized scopes; inspect cached/hidden metadata behavior.
cases.expected: Existing access policy governs active preview, description, and metadata; unauthorized data is not exposed through stale cache or late results; originals are reauthorized.

cases.title: Worker and workload measurement
cases.exercise: Run the declared 1,000-entry fixture with up to 24 visible/buffered cards and two conversion jobs.
cases.expected: Conversion is off render/input callbacks and off main thread; work is bounded/deduplicated; cold/warm timing, long tasks, memory, and bundle results are recorded without unmeasured claims.

cases.title: Historical revision and editor continuity
cases.exercise: Open an artifact editor with unsaved work, inspect another revision, close/reopen Cabinet, and change its presentation.
cases.expected: Existing live editor/runtime state survives under its owner; looking at history does not overwrite or remount away unsaved work.

cases.title: Complete real product journey
cases.exercise: Create real artifacts across two sessions; browse pixel mode; open correct originals; publish revisions; change theme/preference; disconnect/reconnect and reload.
cases.expected: Identity, revisions, descriptions, source-derived previews, original operations, retained drafts, and accepted catalog converge end to end without fixture substitution.
